pair_rule: 128 evenly spaced entries in the ordered 4092 unique training indices, paired consecutively; 64 arbitrary natural-input differences, not semantic matched pairs.
tolerance: Euclidean norm discrepancy / (1 + reference norm) < 1e-9, float64.
scope: Training-only fixed PCA64 span and three prespecified orthogonal coordinate rotations. All256 conditions retained. Local bias-free native MLP polynomial at projected changes; no downstream Transformer evaluation, manifold validity, semantic unit, native channel deletion, or optimization-history claim. Rotated finite interventions are different interventions, while their combined displacement and complete mixed candidate are invariant. Participation reflects both displacement allocation and local operator sensitivity. Stop after arithmetic checks and one synthesis; no rotation search.
